authority: proposed task priorities for retrospective demonstration, not production deployment gates

spam-binary.primary: Do not increase legitimate messages marked spam.
spam-binary.policy: Compare both exact error counts on the same raw-record population. A tradeoff is not an unconditional improvement.

email-main-fresh.primary: Improve correct classification without reducing phishing recall.
email-main-fresh.guardrail: Do not increase legitimate messages falsely labeled phishing.
email-main-fresh.policy: Assess each cohort separately; prior data-informed development prohibits held-out claims.

email-recent.guardrail: No precision or false-positive acceptance claim: this cohort contains only phishing.
email-recent.policy: Never average away a recent-cohort regression with an older-cohort accuracy gain.

banking77.primary: At least 95% of answered predictions agree with the frozen references.
banking77.policy: Compute accuracy and coverage separately; reject-below must not rewrite raw predictions.

clean-code.primary: Find the four explicitly reviewed flaw types without inventing additional labels.
clean-code.guardrail: Scope-inapplicable or missing answers cannot count as reviewed negatives.
clean-code.policy: Synthetic fixtures verify mapping and accounting only. No semantic-accuracy gate is executed.
